title: 025 神目天尊026 神目和他的朋友
content_zh:
：这又矮又胖的家伙降落在灵玉崖前，仔细感知这些玄阴煞雾，神情迅速激动起来，喃喃地说：“师父……师父……您老人家还在……”
管明晦通过满山花草将他的一举一动看得真切，从谷辰的记忆里搜寻出来关于这人的内容。
原来这厮是谷辰的徒弟，出自西方教下，入门之时已经是散仙修为，小有名气，唤做“神目天尊”
谷辰曾经收下过六个正式弟子，四个死在枯竹老人手里，一个是在长眉真人手里，一个死在邓隐手里。
这个神目天尊是他被长眉真人杀死之前收下的，入门不过两三年光景，谷辰那时候已经不是长眉真人的对手，屡遭败绩。
最后谷辰来莽苍山是想取温玉，被长眉真人提前算到，在这里布下埋伏，等他一到便发动仙阵将其困住。
两人激战半日，神目天尊吓得肝胆俱裂，脚底抹油，慌忙逃走。
后来打听师父已死，他怕长眉真人继续追杀他，躲到海外二十多年不敢出来。
如今知道长眉真人已经飞升，峨眉派齐漱溟夫妇转世，又跟五台派越闹越僵，再也无人来注意他，才敢返回中土。
当日的斗法实在太过恐怖，每每想起来，神目天尊都心有余悸。
他这次来，是想看看能不能找到师父当年的法宝，哪怕是一面残破的玄阴聚兽幡也是极好的。
另外也想搜寻当初师父都迫切想得到的那枚温玉。
才到这里便看到满山的玄阴煞气，不禁又惊又喜：“师父还活着……长眉老儿已经飞升，那岂不是要狠狠地报复老儿的徒子徒孙！”
他绕着灵玉崖飞了几圈，没找到师父在哪。
便到灵玉崖前坡上，找了个平溜地，双膝跪倒，磕头祝祷：“师父！
弟子诚心祷告……弟子这些年远走海外，东躲西藏，苦不堪言，恳请恩师怜悯，请您睁开眼，看我多可怜……”
管明晦看这厮长得又丑又蠢，本不想搭理，但他要炼玄阴聚兽幡，又要炼玄阴神幕，需要大量的黑眚丝，人手是越多越好。
他便让崔海客出来，把人引进去。
神目天尊认得崔海客，当年他在南海混过好多年，一见之下很是吃惊：“崔道友也拜入恩师门下了么？”
崔海客尴尬地打了个哈哈：“我何德何能，有机会拜在谷辰前辈门下？不过是得前辈看得起，留我在洞中侍奉些年……”

他说的含蓄，神目天尊没听明白，等到了洞中见到管明晦，虽然容貌跟过去有了很多变化，但看那眼神气质，那周身的玄阴煞气，洞中无风自飘的玄阴聚兽幡，上下浮动的黑眚丝，就知道这肯定是师父谷辰！
普天之下，只有师父谷辰一个人会炼制玄阴聚兽幡，这是绝对假冒不得的！
他噗通一声跪在地上，膝行到石床前面，一把鼻涕一把眼泪哭开了，仿佛是个没娘的野孩子突然找到亲爹，大声倾诉自己这些年到处被人欺负。
最早炼制玄阴寒光镜，花费无数苦功和经历，眼看炼好，被几个峨眉派的弟子突然闯来给毁了。
前些年在海外炼制化血神砂，又是马上大功告成的时候，被路过的天乾山小男随手一道乾天神雷炸得炉倒砂坏，自己也遭到反噬，元气大伤。
“今天总算得天之幸，还能与师父再见，真的是感谢上苍……”
管明晦坐在石床上，冷眼看着他。
根据谷辰的记忆，这家伙本是西方魔教中的有名人物，论辈分比教主毒龙尊者还高了半辈。
只是根骨悟性差了些，修炼魔法，屡次失败走火入魔，使得原本身高八尺的强壮肌肉大汉，变成了如今这副短腿肥猪的模样。
他性情又不好，得罪了好些同门，无奈出走，正遇到谷辰炼宝需要人手，就将他收入座下，玄阴大法只学了入门功夫谷辰就遭了劫数。
“好了！”
content_en:
: This short and fat guy landed in front of Lingyu Cliff. He carefully sensed the mysterious mist. His expression quickly became excited and he murmured: "Master... Master... you are still here..."
Guan Minghui saw his every move clearly through the mountains of flowers and plants, and searched for information about this man from Gu Chen's memory.
It turns out that this guy is Gu Chen's apprentice. He came from the Western teachings. When he started, he was already a loose immortal. He was somewhat famous and was called "Shenmu Tianzun".
Gu Chen once accepted six formal disciples, four of whom died in the hands of Old Man Kuzhu, one in the hands of Master Changmei, and one in the hands of Deng Yin.
This God-Eyed Heavenly Lord was accepted by him before he was killed by the Changmei Master. He had only been in the profession for two or three years. At that time, Gu Chen was no longer a match for the Changmei Master and suffered repeated defeats.
In the end, Gu Chen came to Mangcang Mountain to get Wen Yu, but Master Changmei figured it out in advance and set up an ambush here. When he arrived, he launched an immortal formation to trap him.
The two fought fiercely for half a day. Shenmu Tianzun was so frightened that his liver and gallbladder split. He smeared the soles of his feet with oil and ran away in a hurry.
Later, when he learned that his master was dead, he was afraid that Master Changmei would continue to pursue him, so he hid overseas for more than 20 years and did not dare to come out.
Now that we know that Changmei Zhenren has ascended, Qi Shuming and his wife from the Emei sect have been reincarnated, and the quarrel with the Wutai sect has become more and more stalemate. No one will pay attention to him anymore, so he dares to return to China.
The fighting that day was so terrifying that every time he thought about it, Shenmu Tianzun still had lingering fears.
He came here this time to see if he could find the master's magic weapon. Even a broken Xuanyin Beast Gathering Banner would be great.
In addition, I also want to search for the warm jade that the master was eager to get.
When I arrived here, I saw the mysterious evil energy all over the mountain. I couldn't help but be surprised and happy: "Master is still alive... the old man with long eyebrows has ascended. Doesn't that mean he wants to take revenge on his disciples and grandsons severely!"
He flew around Lingyu Cliff several times but could not find his master.
Then he went to the front slope of Lingyu Cliff, found a flat ground, knelt down on his knees, kowtowed and prayed: "Master!
Disciple prays sincerely... I have been traveling overseas and hiding in Tibet over the past few years. I have suffered terribly. I beg you to have mercy on me. Please open your eyes and see how pitiful I am..."
Guan Minghui saw that this guy was ugly and stupid, so he didn't want to talk to him, but he wanted to refine the Xuanyin Beast Gathering Flag and the Xuanyin Divine Screen, which required a lot of black silk, so the more manpower the better.
He asked Cui Haike to come out and bring the people in.
Shenmu Tianzun recognized Cui Haike. He had lived in Nanhai for many years. He was very surprised when he saw him: "Did Taoist Cui also join the disciples of his mentor?"
Cui Haike laughed out loud in embarrassment: "How can I be worthy enough to have the opportunity to become a disciple of Senior Gu Chen? I just want Senior to think highly of me and keep me serving in the cave for a few years..."
He said it implicitly, but the Divine Eye Master did not understand it. When he saw Guan Minghui in the cave, although his appearance had changed a lot from the past, but looking at the look and temperament in his eyes, the Xuan Yin evil spirit around him, the Xuan Yin beast gathering flag floating in the windless cave, and the black silk floating up and down, he knew that this must be Master Gu Chen!
In the whole world, Master Gu Chen is the only one who can refine the Xuanyin Beast Gathering Flag. This cannot be faked!
He knelt on the ground with a pop, and walked to the stone bed with his knees, crying with snot and tears, as if he was a wild child without a mother who suddenly found his biological father and confided loudly that he had been bullied everywhere over the years.
The earliest refinement of the Xuanyin Cold Light Mirror took countless hard work and experience. Just as it was finished, several disciples of the Emei Sect suddenly came in and destroyed it.
A few years ago, when I was refining the Blood God Sand overseas and was about to finish it, a young man from Tiangan Mountain who was passing by casually blasted the sand from the furnace with a Godly God's Thunder. I also suffered a backlash and my vitality was severely damaged.
"I am finally lucky to be able to see Master again today. I am really grateful to God..."
Guan Minghui sat on the stone bed and looked at him coldly.
According to Gu Chen's memory, this guy was a famous figure in the Western Demonic Cult.He is half a generation older than the leader, Venerable Poison Dragon.
It's just that his understanding was a bit poor. He practiced magic and repeatedly failed and became obsessed with it, turning the eight-foot-tall muscular man into the short-legged fat pig he is now.
He had a bad temperament and offended many of his fellow disciples, so he had no choice but to run away. When Gu Chen needed help for refining treasures, he took him under his seat. Gu Chen only learned the introductory skills of Xuanyin Dafa and suffered a disaster.
"alright!"
